_doc: Machine-readable user-facing text for the OpenCAD web shell, en/zh-CN/ja. Shape is aligned with the sibling oss-alternatives/apps/openmath/web/web-i18n.json (schema <app>.web-i18n/v1, same top-level blocks). Substance differs on purpose and the difference is declared in alignment.mode: OpenCAD's copy comes from the shipped cadcore language packs, and those packs carry en/zh-CN values in the wrong language, so every locale here is the FULL 262-key pack with those values repaired (37 en rows, 31 zh-CN rows; ja needed nothing). Do not hand-edit: the generator lives in the d4 seat report directory /hf3fs-jd/data/tmp/web-i-d4/scripts/30_build_web_i18n.py (the Lead owns repo commits); re-run it, then re-run 70_check_web_i18n.py.

consumers.how: cadcore.i18n.catalog scans ONE language per file, so this bundle cannot be loaded directly: split it with 40_split_overlay.py into <dir>/{en,ja,zh-CN}.json + languages.json and start the app with OPENCAD_I18N_DIRS=<dir>. Verified end to end by 50_wire_and_verify.sh (/api/state serves these exact values, strings_missing=[] in all three locales). OPENCAD_I18N_DIRS REPLACES the default dirs, and pointing it at web/ alone yields a catalog with valid=false / keys=-1 (loud failure, not a half-fix) -- see 56_control_bad_wiring.sh.

GET /web/web-i18n.json is served by the existing static route (HTTP 200, application/json). The shipped web/js/app.js does NOT fetch it today: it fills every [data-i18n] node from /api/state strings. A future page-side consumer should take catalogs[active_locale].strings and overlay them on the active pack per key, in the order below.

resource.key_equality: en/zh-CN/ja have identical 262-key sets, byte-equal to the shipped cadcore pack key sets; brace placeholder names match one by one (checked by C3/C8)
resource.aliases_note: aliases merges the two live resolvers: web/js/app.js KEY_ALIAS + server.py UI_ALIASES
resource.not_in_scope: no new key space: no key outside the three shipped packs is introduced, so the cadcore invariant 'three packs share one key set' is preserved. Server-side error codes travel through these same packs.；例外（2026-10-06 x5-m4）：alignment.web_only 列出的键是页面自己引用、而三份 shipped pack 里没有的词条（help.* / hint.*），只存在于本 bundle，由 web/js/app.js 作为**缺键兜底**消费（服务端 strings 有真译文时一律以服务端为准，本层不覆盖）。除这些键以外不引入新键空间。

fallback.cadcore_chain_rule: cadcore.i18n.catalog.resolve_chain truncates the BCP-47 tag and always ends on en: zh-CN -> [zh-CN, zh, en], ja -> [ja, en], en -> [en]; the chain above is the declared _meta.fallback hop of each pack

derive_from_key.rule: tail after the last '.'; map '_' and '-' to ' '; collapse whitespace; uppercase the first character

visible_marker.shown_text: the derived ASCII tail itself (e.g. 'Rectangle'), NOT a bracketed key marker -- openmath's shell uses a marker, opencad's does not; both flag the node

resource_unreadable.page_behaviour: keep the derived text and set data-i18n-missing=1; never leave a node empty
resource_unreadable.server_behaviour: report the pack as unreadable (valid=false / keys=-1), never as 0 keys

alignment.pack_shape: {_meta: {_doc, code, native_name, fallback, font_fallback, default_standard, license, source, version}, strings: {<prefix>.<name>: text}}
alignment.drift_gate: 70_check_web_i18n.py: C5/C6/C7 carry positive controls over the shipped packs (ruler must hit 37/14/26 before its zero on this file counts), C9/C9b prove every correction row's before/after matches the packs and this file, C3 proves key-set equality. 30_build_web_i18n.py --check proves the file is byte-reproducible.
